description: Modifies a prompt in your prompt library. Include both fields that you want to keep and fields that you want to replace.

researchLinks.description: We Found Eight Attack Vectors Inside AWS Bedrock. Here's What Attackers Can Do with Them

securityImplications: Attackers might use UpdatePrompt to poison a managed Bedrock prompt template, injecting instructions that subvert every agent or flow that uses it, with the change taking effect in-flight and without redeployment.
